description: Build nextjs-ai-saas starter - AI chat and content generation with Next.js, Clerk, Neon/Prisma, OpenAI-compatible API, and Lemon Squeezy. Must follow Web SaaS blueprint exactly as nextjs-supabase-saas does. Create on branch feat/nextjs-ai-saas from current HEAD.
steps: Create and checkout branch feat/nextjs-ai-saas from current HEAD (feat/astro-beginner-static-site)

Create nextjs-ai-saas/ directory with exact-pinned Next.js 15 App Router scaffold (package.json with pnpm 10.x packageManager field, exact versions for next, react, react-dom, typescript, @clerk/nextjs, @prisma/client, prisma, ai (vercel ai sdk), openai, @lemonsqueezy/lemonsqueezy.js, tailwindcss, vitest, fast-check, eslint, eslint-config-next, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom)
Add starter.json matching catalog entry (id:2, folder:nextjs-ai-saas, family:Web SaaS, etc.)
Create domain/entities.ts with Workspace, Conversation, Message, Generation, Entitlement, ProcessedEvent interfaces
Create domain/policies.ts with deny-by-default authorization: workspace ownership check, generation entitlement check

Create lib/server/config.ts with typed ConfigSpec for CLERK_SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY, LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts following the same pattern as nextjs-supabase-saas (DomainError, AuthenticationError, AuthorizationError, WebhookVerificationError, etc.)
Create prisma/schema.prisma with Workspace, Conversation, Message, Generation, Entitlement, ProcessedEvent models targeting postgresql
Create prisma/migrations/ with initial migration SQL
Create lib/server/auth.ts - Clerk adapter for identity extraction from request
Create lib/server/ai.ts - AI port interface (generateResponse) and lib/server/ai-fake.ts with deterministic fake

Create lib/server/billing.ts - Lemon Squeezy BillingPort interface (createCheckout, verifyWebhook, handleWebhookEvent) and lib/server/billing-fake.ts with in-memory fake (same pattern as nextjs-supabase-saas Stripe fake)
Create lib/server/database.ts - Prisma-based repository for all domain entities
Create lib/server/providers.ts - provider selection (real vs fake based on placeholder detection)
Create middleware.ts using @clerk/nextjs for route protection
Create app/page.tsx - public product entry page describing the AI SaaS
Create app/auth/ routes - Clerk sign-in/sign-up pages
Create app/dashboard/ - protected layout with sidebar; pages for conversations, generations, and billing
Create app/api/chat/route.ts - server-only AI generation endpoint that records usage
Create app/api/webhooks/lemonsqueezy/route.ts - webhook endpoint with raw body + signature verification, idempotent event processing
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts - authorization policy unit tests
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts - Lemon Squeezy fake adapter tests (verify, handle events, deduplication)
Create tests/unit/server/ai.test.ts - AI fake adapter tests
Create tests/unit/server/config.test.ts - config validation tests
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts - unauthenticated denial, unauthorized denial tests
Create tests/integration/actions.test.ts - core use-case action (generate response) tests
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts - Property 4: Authentication and access consistency
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts - Property 5: Webhook authenticity gates one state transition (Lemon Squeezy)
Create tests/property/secret-boundary.test.ts - Property 3: No server secrets leak to client bundle
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts - build verification
Create .env.example with classified sections (client-safe, server-only)
Create README.md documenting setup, architecture, auth, schema, monetization, AI provider, tests, deployment
Add vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, next.config.ts, tailwind config
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Verify: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build all pass
Git commit all files on feat/nextjs-ai-saas branch
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-ai-saas/ directory exists at repo root with all Web SaaS blueprint files
starter.json matches catalog entry id:2 exactly
pnpm run test passes (all unit, integration, property, and smoke tests)
Fake adapters activate when env vars are placeholder values
Property tests use fast-check with at least 100 runs each
Webhook verification test covers valid proof acceptance and invalid proof rejection
No server secrets appear in client-safe code paths
verification: cd nextjs-ai-saas && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
findings: Build requires placeholder env values in .env file for Next.js static page generation to succeed (Clerk requires publishable key at build time). Auth pages use plain HTML when Clerk key is placeholder. Layout conditionally wraps ClerkProvider only when real key is present. @lemonsqueezy/lemonsqueezy.js v3.4.1 not available, used v4.0.0. fast-check 3.x does not have fc.alphanumeric(), used fc.hexa() instead. All 79 tests pass, lint/typecheck/build all green.
